params.caption:
🎮 Xbox is finally going to brand its own games as Xbox.

Xbox's new Chief Strategy Officer Matthew Ball confirmed Microsoft will link the Xbox brand more tightly to its first-party games — starting in 2027.

📌 Key facts:
• Responding to criticism that Xbox rarely brands big new titles (Fallout, StarCraft, Diablo V, The Elder Scrolls VI, a new Wolfenstein) as "Xbox" games, Ball agreed the company "hasn't done well" at this.
• His reply on X: "We are fixing this. Will roll out in 2027."
• Windows Central notes this could mean marketing tentpole franchises (Minecraft, Call of Duty, Fallout) more explicitly under the Xbox name, though Microsoft hasn't detailed exactly how.
• Ball was hired earlier this year to help steer Xbox's turnaround strategy.

🕒 Published: Nov 26, 2026, 21:57 GMT+3

📰 Sources: Windows Central

👥 x.com/Xbox
